subject: Change request: add capacity + pricing amendment for Nova Analytics
messages:
From: Elena Santos <elena.santos@nova-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@nova-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: change order to add reserved capacity + pricing

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is eager to move forward. We've run a quick internal forecast and need to request an amendment to our current Order Form to: 
- Add two additional dedicated GPU nodes (reserved capacity) effective July 15
- Update per-token pricing for embeddings for the additional capacity (proposal: 6% discount on current rate for committed nodes)
- Clarify SOW work for a one-week migration window and acceptance criteria

I've attached a short change request doc with the items annotated. Can Redwood provide a draft amendment (redline of the Order Form + MSA paragraph calling out effective date and billing) and confirm whether this requires a separate PO? Our procurement team will need the estimated monthly spend for the added capacity to get internal approval.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — can we aim to have a draft by EOB Friday?

Best,
Elena

--
Elena Santos
Director of Product
Nova Analytics
[Attachment: Nova_Change_Request_Jun24.docx (docx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Santos <elena.santos@nova-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Raj Patel <raj@nova-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: change order to add reserved capacity + pricing

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the doc. Looping in our contracts lead (Marissa) and pricing partner (Karthik) to draft the amendment and confirm billing/PO flow. Quick notes from my side: 
- We can provision two additional dedicated nodes for a July 15 start; we'll need a signed amendment and updated billing instructions before provisioning.
- I will get an estimated monthly cost within the hour for procurement (assuming current committed pricing + proposed discount).

Marissa / Karthik — would you be able to produce a redline of the current Order Form + a short MSA amendment paragraph? Elena asked for a July 15 effective date and a one-week migration window in the SOW. Also flag any change that would require legal approval beyond the standard amendment.

Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0123
ben.carter@redwood-inference.com

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Elena Santos <elena.santos@nova-analytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Raj Patel <raj@nova-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: change order to add reserved capacity + pricing

Hi all,

Thanks for the details — I reviewed Elena's change request and put together redlines to the Order Form and a short amendment to the MSA. Key items I flagged: 
1) Effective date / billing: we can set the amendment to be effective July 15 but we'll include an invoicing note that charges for the added capacity will begin on the first invoice after provisioning. If Nova needs charges to start July 15 precisely, we need a PO with that start date.
2) Term / commitment: adding dedicated nodes will increase committed spend; I added language clarifying the commitment term and early termination consequences.
3) SOW: your requested migration window is reasonable; I added an acceptance criteria section and a one-week go-live support window.
4) Pricing discount: I left the % discount as a fillable field (we should confirm with Finance).

Attached: Redwood_Amendment_v1.docx (clean draft) and Redlines_Redwood_Marissa.docx (with inline comments). Please review — Ben, can you confirm whether Finance is okay with the 6% suggestion or if we need approval for anything above 5%?

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
[Attachment: Redwood_Amendment_v1.docx (docx)]
[Attachment: Redlines_Redwood_Marissa.docx (docx)]

From: Raj Patel <raj@nova-analytics.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Elena Santos <elena.santos@nova-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: change order to add reserved capacity + pricing

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from procurement: 
- We will issue a PO if the amendment shows July 15 as the effective date and the monthly estimate is provided. Could you add an "estimated monthly charge" line to the amendment or provide a one-line summary we can include in the PO?
- On pricing: Finance will approve up to 5% discount without extra signoff; anything above 5% needs VP approval. If Redwood can do 5% we can proceed faster.

Elena, Ben — we want to close this by next week if the docs are final.

Raj
Head of Procurement | Nova Analytics

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Santos <elena.santos@nova-analytics.com>, Raj Patel <raj@nova-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: change order to add reserved capacity + pricing

Hi Raj / Elena — quick status update and next steps: 
- Finance confirmed we can absorb a 5% discount on the committed nodes without escalation. I'll reflect 5% in the amendment.
- Attached is the redline I pulled together based on Marissa's changes (we preserved the MSA amendment language and added an "Estimated Monthly Charge" placeholder that will be filled once Finance's final numbers are calculated). I've uploaded the doc to DocuSign and sent it to Elena for signature: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/ABC123-sign 
- Once signed, provisioning can target July 15. Please confirm whether Nova prefers provision during a maintenance window (we generally recommend a 2-hour window during off-peak).

Elena — can you confirm who will sign from your side and whether procurement will route a PO? If we get signature + PO by Friday we can meet the July 15 provisioning date.

Thanks — Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[DocuSign: Redwood_Amendment_v1 (sent)]
